sources.entry: UrBackup - UrBackup is Client/Server network backup for Windows, macOS and Linux.

summary.one_liner: UrBackup backend source code for UrBackup, a client/server network backup system for Windows, macOS and Linux.
summary.what_it_does: The README is brief and points to the project website, wiki, forums and issue tracker for user documentation. It describes how to build the backend on Linux: a switch_build.sh script selects server or client mode, then autoreconf, configure and make build the code. It notes a separate readme-macos.md for macOS builds. For Windows it describes running update_deps.bat to fetch dependencies, then compiling UrBackupBackend.sln in Visual Studio 2015, with build_client.bat and build_server.bat producing installers. The README does not describe the backup features themselves in detail.
use_cases: compile network backup software on Linux
compile backup client on Windows with Visual Studio
build installers for backup client and server
notable: Single codebase switched between server and client builds with switch_build.sh
Supports Windows, macOS and Linux per the description
Windows build pulls dependencies via update_deps.bat
Separate macOS build guide in readme-macos.md
caveats: Windows build expects Visual Studio 2015 and installer builds need many extra tools such as WiX and NSIS with plugins
README is short and defers user documentation to an external website
